meta.title: SolarMan Diagnostics - Deye in Home Assistant
meta.description: Deye inverter diagnostics over SolarMan TCP and Modbus RTU, independent register catalogs, and MQTT integration with Home Assistant.

hero.title: One device map. Two communication paths.
hero.lede: Read telemetry, compare SolarMan TCP with direct Modbus RTU, and publish selected entities to Home Assistant through one shared MQTT connection.
hero.signalDual: SolarMan TCP and RS485 can run side by side
hero.signalCatalogs: Telemetry and control use independent catalogs
hero.signalMqtt: One MQTT identity without duplicated entities

capabilities.title: A complete inverter view without committing to one transport
capabilities.lede: Verify what the device actually exposes, choose a source per entity, and keep the configuration understandable.

transports.title: Two independent transports
transports.body: The SolarMan logger provides convenient network communication while Modbus RTU gives direct access over RS485. Each transport has its own schedules, delays, and reconnect behavior.

telemetry.title: Telemetry and status values
telemetry.body: Numbers, text, dates, enums, and bitmasks are decoded using the selected model catalog. RAW values remain available for diagnostics.

controls.title: Controlled writes
controls.body: Control entities apply validation, read-before-write, FC16 writes, and read-back verification. Unconfirmed definitions remain read-only.

custom.title: Custom sensors and formulas
custom.body: Add individual registers, decode status values, or create local formulas that combine several reads. The diagnostic test always remains read-only.

catalogs.title: Catalogs selected independently
catalogs.body: Use telemetry from one provider and controls from another, or disable either list. SHA-256 checks protect downloaded definitions.

gallery.title: From register discovery to custom formulas
gallery.lede: Compare transports, select MQTT entities, and keep telemetry sources independent from control sources.
gallery.sensorsAlt: SolarMan Diagnostics sensor panel with scan results
gallery.sensorsCaption: Sensors - decoded states, RAW values, and SolarMan TCP versus Modbus RTU comparison.
gallery.controlsCaption: Controls - current state, entity type, and explicit MQTT publishing selection.
gallery.customCaption: Custom sensors - local formulas and read-only diagnostic tests.
gallery.catalogsAlt: Independent telemetry and control catalog sources
gallery.catalogsCaption: Catalog sources - telemetry and controls can come from different providers.

reference.title: Find the register before wiring it into an automation
reference.body: The browser is generated directly from catalogs in the repository. Select a model, search register numbers, and inspect masks, ranges, transports, and access methods.

install.title: Start in three steps
install.step1Body: Add the SolarMan Diagnostics add-on repository to the Home Assistant store.
install.step2Body: Enter your SolarMan logger details, select an RS485 device, or configure both connections.
install.step3Body: Compare readings and select entities published through MQTT Discovery.
